A copy of the registration certificate of organizations providing human resource services, registered with the Labor Department.

A copy of the EPF registration certificate and the Chillan and settlement record of payments made to at least 30 employees in the year 2024-25 and 2025-26 must be compulsorily submitted.

GST registration copy and copies of GST paid in the last 2 years
A copy of the professional tax certificate and copies of the challans paid for the years 2024-25 and 2025-26. (PT Clearance Certificate 2025-26)
Submitting a notarized certificate stating that the organization is not listed in the blacklist and is not a public representative
